title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

Approximate reader-union envelope, conditional on course speed. This envelope includes reader and endpoint uncertainty; it is not a confidence interval, normal/abnormal classification, or proof of beat-to-beat physiological variation.

fields.value: Approximately regular ventricular spacing over this short strip, with a conditional mean rate near 137 bpm. The accepted conditional QRS range is 0.04-0.11 s, below the course 0.12-s threshold under the timing assumption. Atrial identity remains unresolved; sinus tachycardia is one hypothesis requiring confirmation of uniform sinus P waves before every QRS. Constant PR timing and the course PR range of 0.12-0.20 s are not established.

limitations: New wave-field estimates remain provisional and unscored. Range width reflects uncertain endpoints and reader disagreement, not a validated diagnostic category. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established.
The exact original PDF was checked. The inspected waveforms are embedded rasters; larger rendering does not add samples. Expert interpretation may still improve unresolved component identification.
